official.deadline_note: Application window for the 2026/2027 first (April) call ran 5 May - 5 June 2026, both inclusive; the closing date was extended from 29 May 2026 by resolution of 27 May 2026. Documentation claim period 12 - 26 June 2026. As of 10 October 2026 no October 2026/2027 (second) edition had been published on the UB e-Office; the 2025/2026 October edition ran 21 October - 14 November 2025.
official.status_note: The 2026/2027 first (April) call closed on 5 June 2026 and the documentation claim period ended on 26 June 2026. The programme publishes a second, October edition each year, but no October 2026/2027 call had been published on the UB e-Office as of 10 October 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording (base 3): the call may also provide for the financing of the tuition fee for some master's degrees depending on the budgetary availability of each research centre or group. The annex of the 2026/2027 first call specifies no tuition financing for any of the 17 scholarships.
benefits: 413,07 EUR gross per month for 15 hours of collaboration per week (275,33 EUR gross per month for the 10-hour IQTCUB scholarship)
Economic perception is proportional to the period in which the collaboration is actually provided
Registration with Social Security during the collaboration, with the worker's contribution deducted monthly from the remuneration
The call may also provide for the financing of the tuition fee for some master's degrees depending on the budgetary availability of each research centre or group
Integration into a consolidated research group under a tutor, with a training plan, seminars and, for some groups, the possibility of attending national and international congresses
eligibility: Be enrolled, as a new full-time student, in a University of Barcelona master's degree linked to the scholarship at the time of accepting the scholarship, or be enrolled in the second year of a 90 or 120 ECTS master's carrying out the master's final project

Not have held a collaboration scholarship in the same unit, external entity, faculty or the Institute for Professional Development (IDP) during the twenty-two consecutive months immediately preceding the call
Not have previously completed a training plan identical to that of the scholarship applied for (considered completed if at least 75% of the duration was served)
Have oral knowledge of Catalan and Spanish
Be in possession of a DNI or NIE
Meet the specific requirements and merits of the annex for each scholarship
requirements: Requirements must be met on the day the application deadline ends and maintained throughout the duration of the scholarship, except student status, which is accredited by submitting the enrolment

The minimum average grade thresholds per branch of knowledge set by each scholarship: 6.00 for Engineering, 6.50 for Sciences or Experimental Sciences and Social and Legal Sciences, 7.00 for Arts and Humanities, and 7.25 / 7.50 for the Faculty of Chemistry call
A documented master's final project (TFM) proposal to be developed within the research group, signed by the person responsible for the scholarship and by the person recorded as TFM tutor
To sign the acceptance of the scholarship the beneficiary must be enrolled with a DNI or NIE; enrolment with a passport is not accepted
documents: Copy of the enrolment if the master's is interuniversity and the UB is not the university of enrolment, or if the applicant is a student of an affiliated centre

Personal academic certificate (original or compulsed photocopy) of the university studies giving access, with marks in the form S, A, N, E, MH, quantitative marks, credits and dates, plus the corresponding sworn translation where applicable, for new-access students with no UB academic record

Declaration of equivalence of the average grade of the studies giving access, issued by the Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities, for studies taken abroad (a declaration issued by ANECA may also be submitted)
Curriculum vitae, entered in the section enabled for this purpose in the online application
selection_criteria: Academic record, valuing the marks of the academic record as approved by the Governing Council and in accordance with article 5.a of the collaboration scholarship regulations
Suitability of the candidate assessed on the curriculum or by interview, where appropriate, up to a maximum of six points, taking into account only contributions duly documented in the curriculum
Some calls value knowledge of English or other foreign languages

Unsuccessful applicants may form a waiting list; in the event of a withdrawal the scholarship may be granted to a person on the list for the remaining time, provided it is equal to or greater than three quarters of the expected duration
coverage: Monthly economic endowment paid as remuneration for the collaboration hours actually provided: 413,07 EUR gross per month at 15 hours per week (275,33 EUR gross per month at 10 hours per week)
Possible financing of the master's tuition fee for some master's degrees depending on the budgetary availability of each research centre or group
Income tax withholding and the worker's Social Security contribution are applied to the economic endowment
application_method: Complete the application electronically, after authentication, through the University of Barcelona e-Office (seu.ub.edu)
Attach the documentation specified in base IV electronically to the application
Once the application has been confirmed, no modifications can be made; withdrawal is possible once in order to make a new application, and a second waiver prevents applying again
The award resolution is published on the notice board of the UB e-Office and the responsible unit or centre contacts the successful applicants
official.application_route: Apply online through the UB e-Office (seu.ub.edu) after authentication, attaching the CV, the academic certificate, the foreign average-grade equivalence declaration if applicable, and the signed master's final project proposal.
official.study_mode: full-time (enrolment as a new full-time student in the linked master's is required)
official.citizenship_residency: No nationality restriction is published. Applicants must hold a DNI or NIE; foreign beneficiaries are accredited through their NIE and cannot be enrolled with a passport only.
official.international_eligibility: International students are eligible. For studies taken abroad the applicant must submit the Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities declaration of equivalence of the average grade (an ANECA declaration is accepted), and foreign beneficiaries receive the economic amount via their NIE.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Each scholarship is linked to specific official master's programmes and to a named proposing unit: Facultat de Dret, Facultat d'Economia i Empresa (RiskCenter), Facultat de Filosofia, Facultat de Farmàcia i Ciències de l'Alimentació, Facultat de Física, Facultat de Matemàtiques i Informàtica, Facultat de Química and the Institut de Química Teòrica i Computacional (IQTCUB).
official.research_requirement: The beneficiary must carry out a research project within the consolidated research group under the direction of a tutor; in 60-ECTS master's degrees this work is channelled into the master's final project, and in 90 or 120 ECTS master's degrees it serves as preparation for the later master's final project.
official.duration: 1 October 2026 to 30 June 2027 (collaboration period of the 2026/2027 first call)
official.description: The Master+UB programme aims to attract students with a good academic record to take official master's degree studies at the University of Barcelona and to encourage scientific vocations within a research group. Beneficiaries are integrated into a consolidated research group and develop the project presented under the direction of a tutor. The call consists of two editions, one in April and the other in October.
official.program_type: Collaboration scholarship within a research group (Programa Màster+UB), linked to an official master's degree

not_confirmed: English language test requirement (IELTS/TOEFL or MOI rule): the official pages publish no English test requirement for this programme
Tuition fee financing for specific master's degrees: published only as a possibility subject to the budgetary availability of each research centre or group
Living-cost or travel and installation funding: not published for this call
Dates of the October 2026/2027 (second) edition: not yet published on the UB e-Office as of 10 October 2026
verification.notes: Award amount, dedication, collaboration period, eligibility, documents, selection criteria and deadline were read in full from the UB's own call rules and annex (seu.ub.edu) and cross-checked against the UB 2026 remuneration table (ub.edu) and the programme pages.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a paid research-collaboration placement rather than a classic full scholarship: you work 15 hours a week inside a University of Barcelona research group from October to June and receive 413.07 EUR gross a month (about 393.30 EUR net after Social Security and IRPF deductions), with tuition support possible only for some master's and only when the host unit has budget. Applications run through UB's e-Office and require a master's final project proposal already signed by a research-group tutor, so the real bottleneck is securing a group and a supervisor before the window opens. Because the April 2026 round closed on 5 June 2026 and no October edition had been published when this was checked, the next realistic move is to monitor the e-Office and the programme page from early October.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Master's applicants with a strong academic record (average-grade thresholds of roughly 6.0-7.5 depending on branch) who want supervised research experience and a built-in master's final project, and who can work on site in Barcelona.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure full-time admission and enrolment in a UB official master's that is linked to the scholarship
Agree a master's final project with a tutor in the target research group and obtain the proposal signed by both the person responsible for the scholarship and the TFM tutor
Start the Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities average-grade equivalence declaration early for foreign degrees, since it is the usual bottleneck (an ANECA declaration is also accepted)
Obtain or confirm your NIE and check that your enrolment is not recorded under a passport number
Prepare the CV inside the online form and confirm the exact average-grade threshold and named master's list for the scholarship you target
common_rejection_risks: Enrolling with a passport instead of a DNI or NIE, which blocks signing the acceptance
Falling below the specific average-grade threshold for the branch of knowledge
Submitting a master's final project proposal that is not signed by both the person responsible for the scholarship and the TFM tutor
Having held a collaboration scholarship in the same unit, faculty or the IDP within the previous twenty-two consecutive months
Ignoring the documentation claim period, since failing to supply the requested documents within the published window is treated as withdrawal of the application
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Master's tuition fees unless the host unit finances them, visa/residency and NIE costs, and normal living costs in Barcelona; the monthly endowment is calculated at 6.35 EUR per collaboration hour, not as a living allowance.
document_audit: Foreign academic records need the Ministry's equivalence declaration of the average grade, which takes weeks and is the document most often requested late
The academic certificate must show marks as S, A, N, E and MH with quantitative marks, credits and dates, and needs a sworn translation where applicable
Enrolment must be recorded with a DNI or NIE, never a passport only
The CV is entered in the online application, not attached as a file
An enrolment copy is only required for interuniversity master's or students of affiliated centres
alerts: The programme publishes two editions a year, in April and in October, but windows are short (about a month) and dates are not announced far in advance
The April 2026 closing date was extended by one week, so always check the e-Office for an extension resolution before relying on the printed date
Holding the scholarship is incompatible with any paid work and with another collaboration scholarship, though it is compatible with the General Scholarship or the Equity Scholarship

Payment is proportional to the collaboration actually provided and Social Security and IRPF deductions are applied monthly, and the scholarship ends when the academic year in which you are enrolled ends
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply in the UB e-Office after authentication, confirm electronically without further edits, answer any documentation claim within its published window, then receive contact from the unit to sign the acceptance electronically and be registered with Social Security.
